Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ):

What types of AmazonBasics AC units does Atlas Aircon service?

We service all models of AmazonBasics air conditioners, including window units, split systems, and portable air conditioners.

How can I schedule a repair for my AmazonBasics AC unit with Atlas Aircon?

You can schedule a repair by contacting us through our website, phone, or email. We offer convenient booking options and flexible scheduling to meet your needs.

Are the technicians at Atlas Aircon certified to repair AmazonBasics AC units?

Yes, our technicians are certified and have received specialized training to repair AmazonBasics AC units, ensuring high-quality service.

What is included in a standard AmazonBasics AC unit service from Atlas Aircon?

A standard service includes a thorough inspection, cleaning of filters, checking of refrigerant levels, and a performance test to ensure your AC is running efficiently.

How much will it cost to repair my AmazonBasics AC unit?

The cost of repair can vary depending on the issue and the model of your AC unit. We provide transparent pricing and will give you a detailed quote after a diagnostic assessment.

How long will the repair take?

Most repairs are completed on the same day. However, the duration can vary based on the complexity of the repair and availability of parts.

Does Atlas Aircon offer a warranty on AmazonBasics AC repair services?

Yes, we offer a warranty on all repairs, which includes parts and labor. Please contact us for specific warranty terms.

Can Atlas Aircon provide original replacement parts for AmazonBasics AC units?

We use only genuine AmazonBasics replacement parts to ensure compatibility and optimal performance of your air conditioner.

What should I do if my AmazonBasics AC unit is not cooling properly?

If your AC unit is not cooling effectively, please contact us for a diagnostic service. It could be due to various reasons, such as low refrigerant levels, dirty filters, or a malfunctioning compressor.

Does Atlas Aircon offer any maintenance packages for AmazonBasics AC units?

Yes, we offer maintenance packages that are designed to keep your AC unit in top condition, increase efficiency, and prevent future breakdowns. Our packages include periodic inspections and servicing.
